notes.title: Episode Two is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
The next episode of Lust Selection has arrived! Get your copy to continue from where episode one left off.

Ready yourself for its gonna get hardcore from here on.

notes.title: Episode Two arrives 3rd July 2019
notes.notes:
Hey guys, the release of episode two on steam will launch on July 3rd 2019, just a day before Independence day.

If the erotica contained in episode one is a little underwhelming, as in there isn't any full sexual scenes apart from some... what I would consider as teasers then rest assured that episode 2 will be... a lot more hardcore I would say. 

The choices that you decide to make here will shape the game's flow. There will be a lot of choices that you need to make and each of them not just changes the dynamics in this episode but it also impacts what will transpire in the upcoming chapters so please do not conclude the game yet.

We hoped that you have enjoyed the first episode and will continue to look forward to playing episode two.
